questions.q: Why can't Power BI Desktop alone satisfy the Sales Director's request for a weekly refresh?
options: Desktop only refreshes when you click Refresh yourself; the Service is what runs refreshes on a schedule
Power BI Desktop cannot connect to SQL Server at all
Desktop files cannot contain DAX measures
The Sales Director doesn't actually need automatic refresh
questions.explain: A refresh that happens on its own, unattended, requires the Power BI Service, which Desktop alone doesn't provide.

questions.q: Why does scheduling a refresh against AdventureWorks2012 require the On-premises Data Gateway?
options: The Power BI Service can't reach a SQL Server instance on a local machine/network without it
The gateway is only needed for Excel files
AdventureWorks2012 is a cloud-only database
Gateways are optional and have no real purpose
questions.explain: An on-premises SQL Server source needs the gateway as the bridge the cloud Service can talk through.

questions.q: What happens if the dataset isn't bound to a registered gateway data source?
options: Scheduled refresh either won't appear as an option or will fail with a connection error every time it runs
The report will refresh correctly anyway
Power BI will automatically create a cloud copy of the database
Nothing changes; binding is purely cosmetic
questions.explain: Without a bound gateway data source, the Service has no path to the on-premises SQL Server, so scheduled refresh fails.

questions.q: What should be added to the scheduled refresh configuration to avoid a stale report going unnoticed?
options: A failure notification email
A second, unrelated dataset
A password reset reminder
A duplicate copy of the Executive Summary page
questions.explain: Failure notifications surface a broken refresh immediately instead of letting stale data go unnoticed.

questions.q: What is a good way to confirm the gateway path actually works before trusting the unattended schedule?
options: Trigger a manual 'Refresh now' from the dataset's settings
Delete and recreate the dataset
Wait a full week and check the numbers then
Uninstall the gateway and reinstall it
questions.explain: A manual refresh test confirms the gateway and credentials work correctly before relying on the schedule unattended.
